<div class="card-body">
'''Ket Maliss''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ケット・マリス</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：戦士技能を持たないキャラクターに配備して（ドロイドは除く）、戦士［戦士アイコン］技能を持たせる。２：戦士キャラクターに配備して、戦闘力＋１とする。（「意識操作」の効果を受けない）</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Ket-Maliss-SWCA-100700.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ジャバ・ザ・ハットやギャング達は、暗殺者を重用する。プリンス・シゾールの“シャドウ・キラー”である彼は、モス・アイズリーで血生臭い秘密任務についている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Ket Maliss.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Deploy on a non-warrior character except a droid to give that character warrior skill.

2: Deploy on a warrior character to make its power +1. (Not affected by Alter.).

'''Lore:'''
Jabba the Hutt and other gangsters value assassins highly. Prince Xizor’s “shadow killer” is on a bloody secret mission in Mos Eisley.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text numbers the two options, prints a warrior icon, and uses 意識操作 for Alter.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Ket Maliss]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
